shortDescription: Synchronizes the contents of two directories using Robocopy

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination file/directory to sync (Will receive contents of src).

options.name: flags
options.description: Directly supply Robocopy flags. If set, C(purge) and C(recurse) will be ignored.

options.name: purge
options.description: Deletes any files/directories found in the destination that do not exist in the source. Toggles the C(/purge) flag to RoboCopy. If C(flags) is set, this will be ignored.

options.name: recurse
options.description: Includes all subdirectories (Toggles the C(/e) flag to RoboCopy). If C(flags) is set, this will be ignored.
